policy: FEMA compliance policy (foreign investment, downstream investment and external borrowings)
condition_text: All NBFCs with foreign investment, ECB or overseas investments. Where the NBFC receives direct or indirect foreign investment (e.g., a foreign-owned or controlled parent), raises ECB or holds overseas investments
legal_basis: Foreign Exchange Management Act, 1999; FEM (Non-debt Instruments) Rules, 2019, r. 23 (downstream investment); FEM (Mode of Payment and Reporting of Non-Debt Instruments) Regulations, 2019 (Form DI and other FIRMS filings); RBI Master Direction on External Commercial Borrowings, Trade Credits and Structured Obligations; RBI (NBFC – Supervisory Returns) Directions, 2026, DNBS13

policy: Procedure for handling RBI advisories and supervisory instructions
condition_text: All NBFCs and HFCs
legal_basis: RBI advisories and supervisory communications to NBFCs (issued through DAKSH and the Senior Supervisory Manager). No Direction requires a written procedure; recommended so that every advisory is acted on and evidenced.

policy: Security policy for API-based fund transfer arrangements
condition_text: NBFCs using API-based fund transfer services of banks, directly or through a service provider. Applies where such services are used
legal_basis: RBI advisory NBFC 1 of 2026 (3 Nov 2026) on controls for NBFCs using API-based fund transfer services (confidential – refer to the advisory); RBI (Non-Banking Financial Companies – Cybersecurity, Technology: Risk, Resilience and Assurance Framework) Directions, 2026 (31 Jul 2026, RBI/DoS/2026-27/461)
review: Annual; audit before integration, every year and after a material incident

policy: Compliance risk assessment and compliance testing programme
condition_text: Middle and Upper Layer NBFCs
legal_basis: RBI (Non-Banking Financial Companies – Compliance Function) Directions, 2026 (31 Jul 2026, RBI/DoS/2026-27/460), paras 6, 7, 9(3), 9(4), 15(2), 15(3)
approval: Senior management; review by Board / Audit Committee
review: Annual assessment; review at the periodicity prescribed by the Board (para 6)
